answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow bond: each identity locks 60 credits and files a sonnet, a 14-step stanza drawn from its river of timestamped actions. Auditors replay the river each epoch and match it to the sonnet; a copied stanza or a rented river burns the bond. The k-th fingerprint costs 34+5(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 2,531,500 plus 60,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one true sonnet, crosses the ledge once, and pays 34.
